* **Current Version:** `{current_version}`
* **Latest Version:** `{latest_version}`
common.notification_wan_port_disconnect_message: The WAN port external Internet cable of the ipTIME router ({url}) is unplugged or the modem connection is lost.
common.notification_wan_port_connect_message: The WAN port external Internet cable of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been successfully reconnected.
common.notification_wan_ip_disconnect_message: The ipTIME router ({url}) failed to obtain a public IP, and external Internet communication has been disconnected.
common.notification_wan_ip_connect_message: The ipTIME router ({url}) has successfully obtained the public IP (**{ip}**) and the Internet connection is restored.
common.notification_wan_ip_change_message:
The public IP address of the ipTIME router ({url}) has changed.

* **Previous IP Address:** `{old_ip}`
* **New IP Address:** `{new_ip}`
common.notification_geoip_off_message: The GeoIP foreign IP blocking security feature of the ipTIME router ({url}) is turned off. Traffic from previously blocked regions may now reach the router.
common.notification_portforward_on_message: The Port Forwarding feature of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been turned On. Enabled rules can expose internal services to the internet.
common.notification_portforward_off_message: The Port Forwarding feature of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been turned Off. External access through the configured rules is interrupted.
common.notification_wifi_off_message: The wireless network **{ssid}** ({band} band) of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been disabled. Devices on this network may lose connectivity.
common.notification_acl_on_title: Remote Web Management (Access List) Enabled Warning
common.notification_acl_on_message: The external remote web management (Access List) access port of the ipTIME router ({url}) is now open and active. Hosts on the access list can reach the management page remotely.
common.notification_acl_off_message: The external remote web management access port of the ipTIME router ({url}) has been securely closed and blocked. Remote access through this port is interrupted.
common.notification_csrf_disabled_danger_title: 🔴 CSRF Prevention Disabled Warning (Remote Management Active)
common.notification_csrf_disabled_danger_messag: **[CRITICAL SECURITY RISK]** While remote web management is active on the ipTIME router ({url}), the **CSRF Prevention option has been turned Off**.
common.notification_csrf_security_on_message: The web CSRF cross-site request forgery defense option of the ipTIME router ({url}) is now active.
common.notification_security_csrf_off_danger: Visiting forged websites can lead to settings theft.
common.notification_security_arp_virus_off_dang: Important packets could be easily intercepted.
common.notification_security_syn_flood_off_dang: Traffic floods can overload the router processor.
common.notification_security_smurf_off_descript: Prevents Smurf Distributed Denial of Service attacks.
common.notification_security_smurf_off_danger: Compromised local devices can crash the router.
common.notification_security_ip_spoofing_off_da: Hackers can spoof local trusted IP addresses.
common.notification_security_inbound_ping_off_d: Active presence online is exposed to hackers.
common.notification_security_outbound_ping_off_: Malicious local code can contact external command servers.
